arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case argues that isolation for outside conduct creates a custodial environment.
the opposing side argues that normal prison conditions do not negate interview voluntariness.
Justice Sotomayor questioned the application of the all-circumstances test to custody.
Justice Kagan asked if the test excludes normal prison living circumstances.
